title: MineCrew-Extra
description: List of Minecrew Mods available for the MineCrew-SMP Server

## Description
This modpack delivers the full MineCrew SMP experience, including the complete set of mods, resource packs, shaders, and shader configurations used on the project’s official client. Compared to the lighter version, this pack includes additional features, enhancements, and visuals designed to provide the most complete and polished MineCrew setup.

### What it does
- Includes the full modlist used on the MineCrew SMP project
- Enhances visuals with pre-configured shaders and custom resource packs
- Adds advanced building, utility, and client-side tools
- Bundles performance optimizations while prioritizing feature completeness

### Why you might want it
- You want the complete, intended MineCrew client experience
- You prefer a feature-rich pack with visuals, QoL improvements, and custom tweaks
- You want a ready-to-play configuration without needing to install anything manually

## Important information
- Singleplayer works out of the box.
- Some included client-side mods (e.g., Litematica, Freecam, ClientSort) may not be allowed on every server. Check the rules of any server before joining with this pack.
- This pack does not bypass server protections or modify server-side gameplay in any way.





## Credits
This modpack includes modified and combined versions of multiple Vanilla Tweaks resource packs.
Original source: https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs

All included tweaks were combined and edited to form the following custom packs inside this modpack:
- Tweaks + Vexify Settings
- Redstone Tweaks + Vexify Settings
- Extra Tweaks + Vexify Settings

Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/
